description: Electrical Resistivity Tomography datasets for landslide detection. A case study in Tghat-Fez (Morocco) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. The application of the Electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) Method, in conjunction with the BERT python-based inversion approach, leads to the development of a dependable methodology for fault and landslide identification. The 2D ERT data were collected along nine profiles. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
